::: {#exr-miller-taylor-log-product-exp}
#### Taylor series of $\log((1 - x)e^x)$

Find the first two non-zero terms of the Taylor series for

$$f(x) = \log((1 - x)e^x)$$

at $x_0 = 0$.
:::

::: {#sol-miller-taylor-log-product-exp}
Expand using logarithm properties:

$$f(x) = \log(1 - x) + \log(e^x) = \log(1 - x) + x$$

Substitute the series for $\log(1 - x)$ from @exr-miller-taylor-log-one-minus-x:

$$f(x) = \paren{-x - \frac{x^2}{2} - \frac{x^3}{3} - \dots} + x = -\frac{x^2}{2} - \frac{x^3}{3} - \dots$$

The constant and linear terms vanish ($f(0) = 0$, $f'(0) = 0$). The first two non-zero terms are:

$$-\frac{x^2}{2} - \frac{x^3}{3}$$
:::
